about: The curated giq plugins (ADR-004 D8, ADR-005 D5): what each adds, and what it needs beyond Python. Shipped with each giq release; data only.

plugins.name: giq
plugins.summary: The core: the queue and scheduler, llama.cpp for LLMs, the OpenAI-compatible chat API, the dashboard
plugins.needs: the llama-server binary from llama.cpp, built with CUDA

plugins.name: giq-vllm
plugins.summary: vllm for LLMs: Hugging Face checkpoints, continuous batching, MTP speculation
plugins.needs: vllm's own interpreter, set up once: cd envs/vllm && uv sync; then giq prepare vllm

plugins.name: giq-sdcpp
plugins.summary: Image generation and editing with stable-diffusion.cpp
plugins.needs: the sd-server binary from stable-diffusion.cpp, built with CUDA

plugins.name: giq-speech
plugins.summary: Speech to text with speaker diarization, text to speech, speaker voiceprints
plugins.needs: torch; a Hugging Face token for pyannote's diarization model

plugins.name: giq-ocr
plugins.summary: Documents to text: GLM-OCR with a layout model, and Unlimited-OCR

plugins.name: giq-depth
plugins.summary: Monocular depth maps with Depth Anything V2
